endpoints.name: signup
endpoints.description: Register a new user in the Cognito user pool

endpoints.name: signin
endpoints.description: Authenticate a user and start a Cognito auth session

endpoints.name: verify-otp
endpoints.description: Confirm sign-up with the emailed / texted one-time code

endpoints.name: forgot-password
endpoints.description: Start the forgot-password flow and send a reset code

endpoints.name: verify-reset-otp
endpoints.description: Validate the password reset code before accepting a new password

endpoints.name: reset-password
endpoints.description: Complete the forgot-password flow with a new password

endpoints.name: tokens
endpoints.description: Exchange an authorization code / auth session for tokens

endpoints.name: refresh
endpoints.description: Exchange a refresh token for a new access / id token

endpoints.name: change-password
endpoints.description: Change the password of the signed-in user

endpoints.name: delete-account
endpoints.description: Delete the signed-in user from the user pool

endpoints.name: logout
endpoints.description: Globally sign the user out and revoke their tokens
